name: Macintosh IIci ROM 368CADFE - PiStorm/Emu68 patches
notes: the four dbf loops at 0x40800880/88E/8A4/8BC count down d0.w from 0xFFFF until VIA1
timer 2 interrupts (vector $64 -> 0x40800866 -> jmp (a2)) or d0.w wraps to -1 after
65536 iterations (dbf falls through -> jmp (a2)).  The shared continuation at
0x4080084E does not.w d0, which turns the fall-through value 0xFFFF into 0, i.e. a
very fast CPU stores TimeDBRA = 0 and every derived delay collapses.  Fix: a2 points
to a 10-byte stub in the 14 bytes of zero padding after the last loop (0x408008D2,
nothing references it; the next routine 0x408008E0 is reached by braw from 0x408000B4)
that performs not.w d0 and turns a zero result into 0xFFFF (saturate), then branches
to 0x40800850 (the store).  Normal (slow-CPU) results are unchanged.

patches.name: calib: point a2 (loop continuation) at the saturating stub
calib: saturating stub in the padding gap 0x8D2..0x8DF
asm: not.w   %d0             | d0.w = iterations completed (0 if dbf fell through)
1:      bra.w   calib_store     | -> 0x40800850: move.w d0 to the low-memory global
